passives.name: JokerEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
Every attack rotates between $JokerPassive2 effects:

$Jack:
- The enemy's $FireDoT deals {1}% increased damage for {2} seconds

$Queen:
- Reapply 1 $FireDoT on the enemy based on {3}% of this unit's damage

$King:
- Apply $Fire for {4} ticks over {5} seconds
- Deal {6}% of this unit's current damage

$Joker:
- Apply $Jack, $Queen, and $King

$Queen and $King cannot create more than 1 $FireDoT from this unit on the same enemy.
